title: Dynamically assisted Schwinger pair production in differently polarized electric fields with the frequency chirping
summary: We investigate the enhanced dynamically assisted electron-positron pair production in differently polarized electric fields with frequency chirps within the real-time Dirac-Heisenberg-Wigner formalism. The combined influence of the chirp strength and the field polarization on the momentum distribution and the total number density of the created pairs is studied in detail for one-color fields as well as dynamically assisted two-color combined fields.
